finding: Controller bulk requests were already implemented, but card CMD18/CMD25 forced each callback to one byte. Each callback queried media insertion via a coroutine wrapper.

sample_evidence.note: Inclusive host stack samples, not operation counts or direct total-CPU percentages; BQL contention is not attributed solely to storage.

change: CMD18/CMD25 copy only up to the current validated 512-byte block boundary. No cross-block prefetch or cache; backend reads/writes, RPMB dispatch, range checks, counter and stop handling remain per block. One-byte callers and non-512-byte block sizes retain prior granularity.

coverage: CMD23-counted CMD18 and CMD25 stop transitions
Malformed descriptor rejection and IRQ W1C
Snapshot-only PIO, basic DMA and descriptor write/readback
Original target bytes and image modification time unchanged

benchmark.scope: Host qtest MMIO trigger through synchronous DMA completion. Three trials per binary; full readback compared. Same image and snapshot setup. Earlier QEMU baseline binary contains other unrelated development differences. Not a boot-time, guest-app latency or FPS measurement.

remaining: Measure stock boot/application workload and host profile again; per-sector backend I/O remains, but read-ahead would require additional cache invalidation and partition correctness work.
